name: OpenResearch
one_liner: Runs several research agents in parallel on any model you choose.

text.why: Research handed to an agent runs one thread at a time, so a topic with several branches takes as long as the branches add up to. openresearch runs research agents in parallel and leaves the choice of model to you. It is written in Rust under the MIT license and has its own homepage. The repository description is one line, so supported models and usage have to be read from the docs.
text.take: One agent and one worktree per research direction; built for people who run many experiments.
build: An internal research tool that splits competitor and market work into branches
A comparison run that pits one model's output against another's

who.situation: runs several hypotheses in parallel with a record
tracks experiment variants in a git-based tree
